content.text: •⇡ malig risk: transformation to myelofibrosis, AML, MDS; ⍉curative tx
HA, dizziness, tinnitus, blurred vision, fatigue
•burning pain in hands/ft w/ erythema, pallor, or cyanosis
•thrombosis = leading cause of morbidity + mortality; portal v. + gastric system may be involved
triad of abd pain, ascites, & hepatosplenomegaly
*Budd-Chiari = hepatic venous outflow obstructed by a thrombus w.in a hepatic v.
ex, epistaxis d/t mucosal engorgement & platelet dysfun
many aSx → dx from incidental ⇡Hgb + Hct on CBC
↓ serum EPO; most have JAK2 mut
Bone marrow bx: hypercellularity w/ prominent erythroid, granulocytic + megakaryocytic prolif
Major: ➀ Hgb >16.5 g/dL (men), >16 (women) or Hct >49% (men), >48% (women) or red cell mass >25% above mean nl predicted
➁ bone marrow bx: hypercellularity for age w/ trilineage growth (panmyelosis) + pleomorphic, mature megakaryocytes
➂ JAK2 V617F or JAK2 exon 12 mut
Minor: serum EPO below nl range
may forego bone marrow bx if Hgb >18.5 (men) or >16.5 (women) + ⊕mut + ⇣EPO
low-dose ASA (unless contraindicated — extreme thrombocytosis → acquired vWD, check vWF)
•low-dose ASA treats vasomotor sx + prevents thrombosis
•blood transfusions ⍉part of PV tx (ask about periodic phlebotomy)
•cytoreductive tx lowers plt count + further ⇣thrombosis risk
⚠️ Blueprint "≤60 = low risk" → use <60 · MSD "ASA only if sx" → guidelines: ASA for all unless contraindicated.
